item.title: Paralysed Chinese man runs goose farm, highlighting unusual start-up path for the disabled
item.description: Although he can move only his arms, a paralysed man in central China has built a goose farm and gives all his earnings to his parents. Qi Zhiqiang, 49, grew up in a relatively well-off rural family in Zhoukou, Henan province, with his younger brother. His life took a sharp turn for the worse after he developed a rheumatic illness at the age of 10. With limited access to medical care, he relied on painkillers and antibiotics as his condition progressed to ankylosing spondylitis. By the age of 18,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
